name: Sillitreya
source:
Sillitreya (full name is Sillitreya Taidei) – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change.
Sillitreya is a young red blue-eyed om'verai with a "beck", wearing a pink mask. Sillitreya has 8 red horns, red belly plates and red mane, decorated with golden jewellery.
Sillitreya makes an impression of a curious easy-going journalist, making any attempts to get as much information as she can in order to publish. Sillitreya is skilled enough to differentiate lies and truths.

Sillitreya dislikes aveander due to different recipes it is being used for, compared to Azaries' hometown.
